journal_lines: §lWitch§l in the clearing. §oSugar-and-rot smell on the air before I saw her.§o Closed fast.
Potion landed short. Charged through the smoke. Got my teeth in.
§cSplash hit my flank. §oLegs went numb for a breath.§o Shook it off. Finished it.
Heard the glass break and moved sideways. Kept moving.
Cackle in the trees. Found the source. Dealt with it.
She drank something before I reached her. Got there before it helped.
§oBottles on strings in the branches above her door.§o Didn't touch them. Went straight for her.
Threw three. Two hit the ground. One hit me. Still managed.
§cPotion on my nose. §oWorst smell I've encountered in a long time.§o Kept going.
Cauldron still bubbling when I left. Didn't investigate.
§lWitch§l alone in the rain, mixing something in a clay pot. Not for long.
Moved wide around the hut first. Came back when I knew the layout. Cleared it.
